items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: But he was a better trumpet player than Nick, you know.

ctx.x: Well, he was... The guy was supposed to go with what's called Dixieland Band, to New York, see. But he wouldn't go because he had a meat market with his dad. And so he says, no, I can make more money here. But he was a better trumpet player than Nick, you know. I mean, he moved the band. That's what they said. So... Like, see, Johnny Lala was known, uh... Oh, man. They must have had a lot of good musicians, you know, probably. Well, all the Brunner's boys played good. That's the boy that I work with all the time.…
Just Tony Fernand and I that came out of the band. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
